第二天起床后，吴姜将自己决定好收养念念的事情，和老爹老妈说了。

吴时安没什么意见，王雅琴张了张嘴，想说点什么，最终还是没有开口阻止。

“老爹，老妈，我想过几天，就搬到另一套房子去住。”

吴时安和王雅琴一听，就知道他是什么意思了。之前吴姜给他们讲过，凡人长时间和鬼待在一起，对凡人的身体不好，除非念念以后实力提升了，或者积累了足够的功德护体，这才能不对凡人造成影响。

王雅琴这时忍不住了，问道：“那芽芽以后怎么办？”

吴姜一脸的问号，这关李月芽什么事？

“还装，你就没有考虑过，以后找女朋友的事？”

吴姜有些哭笑不得，这才哪到哪，就想那么远的事情，但还是解释道：“放心吧，老妈，我会找女朋友的，事情也能解决，到时候找一件法器就好了，阴气不能近身就行了。”

既然吴姜都这么说了，王雅琴也就不再多说什么了，她也对念念那丫头很是喜爱。

最关键的一点，念念还不会长大，更能戳动她泛滥的母爱之心了。

大家都知道，小孩子软乎乎、萌萌哒，最是可爱，长大了就不好玩了。

吃过早饭，吴时安就去店里了，王雅琴准备去商场转转，儿子要一个人生活，家里还要添很多的东西。

吴姜说的另一套房子，是老爹老妈给他准备结婚住的，早就装修好了，只是一直没住而已。

那套房子，离现在住的地方并不远，距离李月芽的家里还要更近一点。

吴姜也出门了，和阮柏云电话联系好了，去他家里商量念念的事情。

吴姜开上自己的M9，速度很快的到了锦绣天玺。

After getting up the next day, Wu Jiang told his parents about his decision to adopt Nian Nian.

Wu Shi'an had no objection. Wang Yaqin opened her mouth and wanted to say something, but in the end she didn't stop him.

"Dad, Mom, I want to move to another house in a few days."

Wu Shi'an and Wang Yaqin knew what he meant as soon as they heard it.Wu Jiang told them before that staying with ghosts for a long time is not good for mortals' health. Unless Nian Nian's strength increases in the future, or he accumulates enough merit to protect his body, it will not affect mortals.

Wang Yaqin couldn't help it anymore and asked, "What will Yaya do next?"

Wu Jiang had a question mark on his face, what does this have to do with Li Yueya?

"You're still pretending, but you haven't thought about finding a girlfriend in the future?"

Wu Jiang was a little dumbfounded. He was thinking about such far-off things just now, but he still explained: "Don't worry, Mom, I will find a girlfriend, and the matter can be solved. When the time comes, just find a magic weapon, and the Yin Qi can't get close to me."

Now that Wu Jiang has said this, Wang Yaqin won't say anything more. She also likes that girl Nian Nian very much.

The most important thing is that Nian Nian will not grow up yet, so she can stimulate her overflowing motherly love.

As we all know, children are soft, cute, and the most adorable, but they are no longer fun when they grow up.

After breakfast, Wu Shi'an went to the store. Wang Yaqin was going to go to the mall. His son had to live alone and had to add a lot of things to the house.

The other house Wu Jiang mentioned was given to him by his parents for his wedding. It had been renovated a long time ago, but he had never lived in it.

That house was not far from where I lived now, and even closer to Li Yueya's home.

Wu Jiang also went out, contacted Ruan Boyun on the phone, and went to his house to discuss Nian Nian's affairs.

Wu Jiang drove his M9 and arrived at Splendid Tianxi very quickly.
